name: Eastern State Penitentiary
tagline: A preserved 1829 prison, including Al Capone's cell. Also runs Halloween Nights.
description: The world's first true penitentiary, opened 1829, abandoned in 1971, preserved as a 'stabilized ruin' since 1994. Houses Al Capone's preserved cell. Operates Halloween Nights, the country's most-attended Halloween event, in October.
review_long:
Eastern State was the prototype for the modern penitentiary system: complete solitary confinement was the design principle, and 300+ prisons worldwide copied its radial cellblock layout. Most famous inmate: Al Capone, who served eight months here in 1929–30 (his cell, with rugs, lamps, and a radio, is preserved). The audio tour is narrated by Steve Buscemi.

In October the entire complex transforms into Halloween Nights, a haunted-house experience that's been running since 1991 and books out far in advance.
